Specs from corally.com's page for C-00289-R. Corally lists one gear diff plus a center slipper clutch, and says the car is built on the Syncro-4 platform. ESC is the Torox 135 2-4S per the spec table (the product name says 3-4S, and the description calls the ESC 'PULSE G2 135').

Corally's 2026 update of the Syncro-4 (new body, reinforced chassis bracing, updated CVDs, 15T pinion); Corally's store title is just 'SYNCRO-4'. Specs from corally.com's page for C-00295-R. Three oil-filled gear diffs. The center diff case is molded composite and the diff gear material isn't stated, although Corally describes an 'all-metal 4WD drivetrain'. Torox 135 2-4S ESC.

Out of stock ('Notify me when available') on Redcat's site as of 2026-11-19. Hobbywing 150A ESC (4S-6S LiPo ready); runs on one 4S or 6S pack or two 2S or 3S packs. The Kaiju page doesn't list the diffs. Redcat's parts list tags the same complete center diff (RER13883), front/rear diffs (RER12481) and 2100Kv motor (RER14674) for the Kaiju and the Kaiju EXT. Motor size is from the Kaiju EXT page. Top speed not published.

Out of stock ('Notify me when available') on Redcat's site as of 2026-11-19. Extended-wheelbase (360 mm) version of the Kaiju. Redcat lists three sealed, oil-filled gear diffs with metal internal gears. Hobbywing 150A ESC (4S-6S LiPo ready). Top speed not published.

RLAARLO lists 3 gear diffs (front, center and rear) and says all drive components are CNC-machined 40Cr steel. The spec table lists Power System 2S-6S; the page also says the ESC supports standard 4S and 6S LiPos and needs 30C-50C packs. Price is the regular price (on sale for $499.99).

Kyosho 'Readyset' = ready-to-run without battery/charger. No US price: the Kyosho America site is closed for a rebuild (password page) as of 2026-11-19, so specs are from rc.kyosho.com. The current version is 34118T1S/T2S (KS5072 servo, BRAINZ 8 V2 ESC); Kyosho's page for the earlier 34118T2 shows it out of stock. The center diff has machine-cut metal gears. Kyosho's Japanese page lists one or two 7.4V LiPo (or 7.2V NiMH) packs; the ESC's cell range isn't published. Motor size is from Kyosho's page for part 70602 (40 mm x 68 mm case).

Kyosho 'Readyset' = ready-to-run without battery/charger. Shown out of stock (on sale since January 2026). Kyosho lists two 7.4V LiPo (or 7.2V NiMH) packs with XT60 connectors; the BRAINZ 8 V2 ESC's cell range isn't published. Diffs not described. Solid-axle mini monster truck with front and rear gear diffs and metal telescoping center drive shafts. Includes a 7.4V 750mAh LiPo and USB charger; the cell range of the 2-in-1 ESC/receiver isn't stated. Price is Redcat's regular price (on sale for $143.99).

Includes two 7.4V 800mAh Li-ion packs and a USB charger; LiPo compatibility not stated. Front and rear gear diffs only. Splashproof brushed ESC/receiver. Price is Redcat's regular price (on sale for $95.96).

Redcat calls it 1/6 scale in the product name and description; its Tech Specs table says 'Large Scale'. Three oil-filled gear diffs (front, center and rear); diff gear material not stated. Hobbywing 8BL150-RTR 150A ESC with dual XT90 connectors; needs one 6S or two 3S LiPos, and Redcat says it also performs well on 4S. Replaces the Shredder. Price is Redcat's regular price (on sale for $439.99).

Redcat calls it 1/6 scale in the product name and description; its Tech Specs table says 'Large Scale'. Three oil-filled gear diffs (front, center and rear); diff gear material not stated. Hobbywing MAX10 SCT RTR 120A ESC; Redcat lists one 4S LiPo as needed, and lower cell counts aren't stated. Price is Redcat's regular price (on sale for $359.99).

Redcat calls it 1/5 scale in the product name and description; its Tech Specs table says 'Large Scale'. Three fluid-tunable diffs (front, center and rear) with CNC ring and pinion gears and an aluminum center diff case; center diff gear material not stated. 160A ESC; takes two 3S or two 4S LiPos (6S-8S). Price is Redcat's regular price (on sale for $719.99).

Officially licensed Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution VI Tommi Mäkinen Edition body. RLAARLO lists an all-metal drivetrain with 40CrMn gears, sealed front and rear diffs and a center diff. Battery tray fits 2-6S LiPo; the page says the ESC supports standard 4S and 6S LiPos (30C-50C). Top speed isn't shown on the page. RLAARLO's parts list shares the gearbox, diff and spur gear parts with the DSK buggy. Price is the regular price (on sale for $599.99).
